summary: Phase 2 'Réservation premium' tested end-to-end. BACKEND (13/13 pytest, /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_booking.py) — catalog returns 8 services + 5 vehicles + cancellation_policy.text + flight_tracking=false; /fixed-routes returns >=12 active seeded routes; estimate CDG→Paris airport pax=5 luggage=4 returns pricing='fixed' with prices exactly 75/95/110/140/190 and fits false for standard+premium and true for van/van_premium/group, each option carries image_url/passengers/luggage/category and cancellation_policy; hourly service hours=1 forced to 2 → pricing='hourly' hours=2, standard = 55*2 = 110; city_tour min 3h enforced; Eiffel→Louvre 'private' returns pricing='distance'; POST /rides standard with 5 pax → 422 with capacity message; POST /rides van + flight_number 'AF 1234' → 200, booking_ref matches ^RG-[A-Z0-9]{6}$, fixed_price=true, fixed_route_name set, flight.number normalized to 'AF1234', flight.tracking_error present (no AviationStack key), service_label 'Transfert aéroport', price 110; hourly ride hours=3 vehicle=premium → price 255 hours=3; GET /flights/AF1234 → 503; GET /flights/BAD → 404; moderator (chauffeur@test.com) full CRUD on /admin/fixed-routes → 201/200/422 (bad vehicle key)/200 delete, non-moderator throwaway → 403; complete-then-rate flow returns review {comment,punctuality,cleanliness,driving,vehicle} and second rate → 409. FRONTEND (Expo web preview 390x844, passager@test.com/password123) — service chips visible (service-picker + service-airport…special), tapping service-airport then place-4 (Aéroport CDG T2) reveals trip-details with pax/children/luggage steppers, flight-box with flight-number+airline inputs, fixed-route-name '✓ Trajet à prix fixe : Paris Centre → Aéroport Charles-de-Gaulle', all 5 vehicle-{k} cards with 'Prix fixe — sans frais cachés' badges (vehicle-*-fixed) and cancellation-policy text visible; incrementing pax to 5 (pax-value='5') marks vehicle-standard-nofit + vehicle-premium-nofit; booking van with AF1234 → ride-summary shows booking-ref (e.g. RG-JS3XRS), passagers/bagages counts, flight-card 'Vol AF1234 · Air France' with 'Suivi de vol indisponible – le chauffeur est informé de votre vol' fallback; cancel-ride works. HOURLY flow — reset-dropoff, service-hourly + Louvre → hours-value='2 h', standard vehicle card shows '55.00 € / heure' and 110 €, hours-plus → hours-value='3 h' and price 165 €. MES COURSES — completed/cancelled cards expose book-again-{id}; tapping opens home with pickup='Châtelet'/dropoff='95700 Roissy-en-France' prefilled and vehicle list restored. RIDE DETAIL of past ride — book-again button present. DETAILED REVIEW — on completed unrated ride, rating-box + star-1..5 + crit-{punctuality|cleanliness|driving|vehicle}-1..5 + review-comment + tip chips + submit-rating; after submit, my-review reads '★ Votre note : 5/5 · « Parfait »'. DRIVER (chauffeur@test.com) home online — available ride card shows 'Transfert aéroport', '👥 4 · 🧳 3', '✈️ AF1234', 'Prix fixe' badge. Deprecated packages: none detected. React-Native components/testIDs OK.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/catalog.py: 8 SERVICES + 5 VEHICLES + seeded 12 fixed routes; match_fixed_route picks the smallest-radius match (sound); hourly_price/fits/booking_ref are simple pure functions.
/app/backend/routes/booking.py: /catalog is public (no auth) – fine; moderator CRUD validates vehicle keys and positive prices; flight_status maps ValueError→404 and RuntimeError→503 correctly.

/app/backend/routes/rides.py estimate/build_ride: hours forced to service min, fixed-route matched only when pricing='distance', fits() enforced with 422 including French label; flight_number normalized to uppercase alphanumeric before lookup; tracking_error attached on failure so manual entry still succeeds — matches spec.
rate_ride: filters empty criteria, stores review dict on the ride, updates driver rolling average, 409 on double-rate. Sound.
TripDetailsMixin passes ge/le bounds on all steppers; RideCreateIn inherits all trip details cleanly.
Frontend: RideSummary, VehicleCard, TripDetails, ReviewForm all expose stable testIDs; VehicleCard disables card & shows nofit label when !fits.
Driver home renders service tag only when service_type != 'private' (avoids visual clutter); flight tag colored when delay > 0.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all Phase 2 flows tested (airport fixed-price / capacity fits / hourly stepper / booking + flight card / book-again / detailed review / driver tags)
